---
title: Address-level quality exclusions
date: 2026-11-12
status: APPROVED
---

User confirmed address-level exclusion of all families when any baseline record
fails geocoding quality or registry recency. Missing quality and missing recency
must also exclude, with separate audit reasons. Connect filters to max_geo_dev
and max_cad_outdated. Use sequential, non-overlapping audit counts: unknown quality,
excess geocoding deviation, unknown recency, excessive recency. Preserve the union
of excluded addresses regardless of this reporting precedence. Do not run R or targets.
Verify textual diff; functional checks and audit reconciliation remain pending.
